neighbours.label: the token ' exceed' after a negation, stating a limit (should not exceed 20 kg), as against 'exceed' in positive statements and limits worded without 'exceed'
fire: The total length of the essay must not exceed 2,000 words.
Each carry-on bag should not exceed 7 kilograms.
Daily doses of the medicine may not exceed four tablets.
Your speed on this road shall not exceed 30 miles per hour.
The fee will not exceed ten percent of the sale price.
Please make sure the file does not exceed 5 megabytes.
Annual income that does not exceed the threshold is tax free.
Water temperature in the tank must never exceed 40 degrees.
quiet: Sales this quarter exceeded every forecast the analysts made.
Her performance will exceed what anyone expected of her.
Daily doses of the medicine are limited to four tablets.
Your speed on this road shall stay below 30 miles per hour.
The demand for tickets could exceed supply by a wide margin.
Please make sure the file stays under 5 megabytes.
Profits far exceed the losses from last year.
Water temperature in the tank must remain under 40 degrees.

notes: Probe: 'should not exceed' 0.97, 'will exceed expectations' 0.015, 'surpass' 0.003. Card top 32: ' exceed' x16 (all after 'not'), ' than' x8, ' but' x7.
